title: Image Recording Using Charge-Coupled Devices
version: Advanced Electro-Optical Imaging Techniques, NASA SP-338, chapter IV, pp. 51–68
lineage: NASA’s 1973 publication of the proceedings of the September 1972 symposium. The presentation date and publication year refer to different events.

passages.note: The proceedings date the symposium at NASA Headquarters to 22 September 1972 and identify Séquin as the Bell Labs presenter.

passages.locator: pp. 57–61, Figures IV-8–10; p. 68, refs. 5 and 10
passages.note: Séquin describes transferring a whole captured charge pattern into a separate storage area, then reading the rows through a serial register. He describes a working 128-by-106 device and presents an image acquired at 15 frames/s. He cites the 1971 line-imager paper and the forthcoming technical report for this device.
